notes.title: 1.3.10 (List of players)
notes.content:
Hello people! Another update! In this update, the system of adding and removing players in multiplayer has been completely changed. Bugs related to the player's exit have been fixed.

Now, when you open the chat, you will see a list of players.

A few minor changes:
[list]
[*] the ping of the players is shown
[*] removed the 4x4 map size
[*] you can kick player during the game
[/list]

Now you can change the maximum number of players when creating a lobby. So far, no more than 4, but it is planned to make 8 people!
